title: The Ransomed One
text: In a roadside market, a Lost Scion's cloak hangs on a stall, offered for sale among the old boots and pans. It still smells of them. A note is pinned to the collar. The seller will not meet your eye.

options.label: Buy the cloak and read the note; it may be all that is left of them.

outcomes.text: It is a map in their hand, and the hand was shaking.

options.label: The shrewdest questions the seller to learn where he found it.

outcomes.text: He found it near a cave, he says, and did not go in. He points the way without looking.

options.label: Take the cloak by force. It was never his to sell.

outcomes.text: The whole market turns on you.
